# nxos_keychain (Resource)

This resource can manage the keychain configuration on NX-OS devices, including keychains and their associated key entries.

### API Documentation

- [kcmgrEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/kcmgr:Entity/)
- [kcmgrKeychains](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/kcmgr:Keychains/)
- [kcmgrClassicKeychain](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/kcmgr:ClassicKeychain/)
- [kcmgrKey](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/kcmgr:Key/)
- [kcmgrAcceptlifetime](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/kcmgr:Acceptlifetime/)
- [kcmgrSendlifetime](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/kcmgr:Sendlifetime/)
- [kcmgrMacsecKeychain](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/kcmgr:MacsecKeychain/)
- [kcmgrMacsecKeyId](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/kcmgr:MacsecKeyId/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nxos_keychain" "example" {
  admin_state = "enabled"
  keychains = {
    "KEYCHAIN1" = {
      keys = {
        "1" = {
          cryptographic_algorithm     = "AES"
          key_string                  = "secret_password"
          accept_lifetime_end_day     = 31
          accept_lifetime_end_month   = "Dec"
          accept_lifetime_end_time    = "23:59:59"
          accept_lifetime_end_year    = 2035
          accept_lifetime_local       = "local"
          accept_lifetime_start_day   = 1
          accept_lifetime_start_month = "Jan"
          accept_lifetime_start_time  = "00:00:00"
          accept_lifetime_start_year  = 2025
          send_lifetime_end_day       = 31
          send_lifetime_end_month     = "Dec"
          send_lifetime_end_time      = "23:59:59"
          send_lifetime_end_year      = 2035
          send_lifetime_local         = "local"
          send_lifetime_start_day     = 1
          send_lifetime_start_month   = "Jan"
          send_lifetime_start_time    = "00:00:00"
          send_lifetime_start_year    = 2025
        }
      }
    }
  }
  macsec_keychains = {
    "MACSEC_KEYCHAIN1" = {
      keys = {
        "1000" = {
          cryptographic_algorithm = "AES_256_CMAC"
          key_hex_string          = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
          end_day                 = 31
          end_month               = "Dec"
          end_time                = "23:59:59"
          end_year                = 2035
          local                   = "local"
          start_day               = 1
          start_month             = "Jan"
          start_time              = "00:00:00"
          start_year              = 2025
        }
      }
    }
  }
  macsec_psk_no_show = "enabled"
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`
- `deletion_policy` (String) What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attributes of the objects that already existed and leaves configuration not managed by Terraform in place. `retain` leaves the device unchanged on destroy and only removes the resource from the state. Overrides the `deletion_policy` of the provider, which defaults to `delete`. See the [Deletion Policy](../guides/deletion_policy) guide for details.
  - Choices: `delete`, `reset`, `retain`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `keychains` (Attributes Map) List of keychains.
  - Map key: `name` - Keychain name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keychains))
- `macsec_keychains` (Attributes Map) List of MACsec keychains.
  - Map key: `name` - Keychain name of macseckeychain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--macsec_keychains))
- `macsec_psk_no_show` (String) macsec-psk hide them in show.
  - Choices: `disabled`, `enabled`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = nxos_keychain.example
  identity = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema


#### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform's `import` block requires a non-empty `id` value, so this format cannot be used to
# import nxos_keychain for the default device. Use the `terraform import` command
# below, or identity-based import shown above, instead.
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nxos_keychain.example ""
```
